claims.text: Based on the evidence provided, Google acquired Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal announced on 2025-03-18 [Source: ev-1].
The primary strategic reason for this acquisition was to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure under the leadership of Thomas Kurian at Google Cloud [Source: ev-1].

Regarding what the deal signaled about the cloud-security market, it indicated a focus on cloud-security consolidation as the next battleground in the "cloud wars," driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1].
Additionally, the transaction marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].

Google announced on 2025-03-18 that it would acquire the cloud-security firm Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
This deal followed Wiz's rejection of a previous offer from Google worth $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
The strategic move was driven by Google Cloud under Thomas Kurian to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure [Source: ev-1].
